# VoiceStudio Corporate Contributor License Agreement 1.0

This Agreement lets an organisation license the Contributions its employees
and contractors make to VoiceStudio. It does not transfer the organisation's
copyright. Each covered individual also signs the
[Individual Contributor License Agreement 1.0](CLA-1.0.md) (the "Individual
Agreement") on their first pull request.

This text is fixed. A later version will have a new version number and file,
and will need a new signature.

## How the organisation accepts

An officer or other person authorised to bind the organisation completes the
signature block below and emails a signed copy to `hi@voicestudio.sh`.
The signature must be handwritten, or an electronic signature recognised by
the Information Technology Act, 2000 or the law where the Corporation is
established. The Maintainer keeps the
signed copy and confirms receipt. The Agreement takes effect when the
Maintainer confirms receipt.

## 1. Definitions

- **"Corporation"** means the organisation named in the signature block, and
  any entity that controls it, is controlled by it, or is under common control
  with it.
- **"Designated Contributor"** means an employee or contractor of the
  Corporation listed in Schedule A, as updated under section 5.
- **"Maintainer"** (Yupcha Softwares Private Limited and its affiliates and
  assignees), **"Project"**, and **"Contribution"** have the meanings in the
  Individual Agreement. Here, a Contribution is one submitted by a
  Designated Contributor in which the Corporation has rights.

This Agreement covers every Contribution a Designated Contributor has submitted
to the Project, whether before or after the date it takes effect. It adds to,
and does not reduce, any licence granted earlier for a Contribution.

## 2. Licences

In consideration of the Maintainer's commitment in section 4 of the Individual
Agreement and the Maintainer's review of the Contributions, the Corporation
grants the Maintainer, and recipients of software the Maintainer distributes,
the copyright licence in section 2 and the patent licence in section 3 of the
Individual Agreement, on the same terms, for every Contribution.

The Maintainer may license the Contributions under any terms, including the
GNU Affero General Public License, other open-source licences, and commercial
or proprietary licences. The Corporation intends these licences to cover those
uses, including closed-source commercial products and hosted services, and
forms of use that are not yet known when this Agreement takes effect. These
licences are perpetual, worldwide, and do not lapse if the Maintainer does not
exercise them.

Section 4 of the Individual Agreement (open-source commitment) applies to the
Contributions in the same way.

## 3. Corporation's representations

The Corporation represents that:

1. the person signing is authorised to bind the Corporation;
2. the Corporation has the right to grant these licences for each
   Contribution;
3. each Designated Contributor is authorised to submit Contributions on the
   Corporation's behalf; and
4. to its knowledge, no Contribution infringes the rights of any third party.

Except for these representations, Contributions are provided "as is", without
warranties or conditions of any kind. The Corporation has no obligation to
provide support for Contributions.

## 4. Moral rights

To the extent permitted by law, the Corporation will ensure that moral rights
of its Designated Contributors in the Contributions are waived, or not
asserted, against the uses licensed in this Agreement.

## 5. Designated Contributors

The Corporation keeps Schedule A current by emailing an updated list to
`hi@voicestudio.sh`. Removing a person stops future Contributions from
being covered. It does not affect licences already granted for earlier
Contributions.

## 6. Governing law and general terms

Sections 9 (Governing law) and 10 (General terms) of the Individual Agreement
apply to this Agreement, with "the Corporation" in place of "You".
